name: Queen's Guard
comment: What Queen's Guard summons (SpawnMonster U1XT): the Queen's Guard (TDB #3002) of the live capture in 1200, where 8 of 9 faded 10.1 s after they appeared (it was a guessed Royal Guard for 15 s). Its attack is the pet spell whose server Lua has the owner cast the damage. A summon of its own, apart from npc/queen-s-guard (the live-placed one in 1200).
